en.title: Vision-Language-Delta-Action: Learning Compact Deltas as Actionable Transition Interfaces for Robotic Manipulation
en.summary: Compact Deltas as actionable transition interfaces. 98.5% on LIBERO; zero-shot 84.5% on LIBERO-Plus and 62.9% on RoboTwin 2.0 hard tasks.

zh.title: Vision-Language-Delta-Action: Learning Compact Deltas as Actionable Transition Interfaces for Robotic Manipulation
zh.summary: 以紧凑 Delta 作为可执行的状态转移接口。LIBERO 98.5%；零样本 LIBERO-Plus 84.5%、RoboTwin 2.0 困难任务 62.9%。

authors: Lingyun Zhang, Henghua Zhang, Shilei Gu, Kai Mo, Shuai Han, Shiyong Li, Yanpeng Wang, Dou Shen

en.title: TAOT: Topology-Aware Optimal Transport for Dynamic Expert Replica Placement in MoE Training
en.summary: Topology-aware dynamic expert replica placement that tackles EP load imbalance in MoE training: up to 74% lower overhead than industry solutions, and a 1.43× speedup on a real training case.

zh.title: TAOT: Topology-Aware Optimal Transport for Dynamic Expert Replica Placement in MoE Training
zh.summary: 拓扑感知的动态专家副本放置，解决 MoE 训练中的 EP 负载不均衡：开销较业界方案最高降低 74%，在真实训练案例中实测 1.43× 加速。
